item: A source that fails inside ingest no longer ends the whole pass when the pool is exhausted: the failure handler reads the domain before the try, not from an expired row
summary: Cause of the dead lab runs (B-pool24 run 1, G0 run 1, the G0 diagnostic run): _process_source logged a failure with getattr(source, 'domain', '?'). The failure had rolled the worker session back, which expires every attribute, so that read reloaded the row through a pooled connection; with the pool exhausted it timed out (QueuePool limit, 30 s) inside the except block, escaped, and the pass ended with the remaining sources unscraped. The label is now read before the try (any read error gives '?'), so the handler asks the pool for nothing. Red without: a stub ingest that rolls back and arms a pool timeout on the next checkout from inside _process_source; unfixed, the pass raises sqlalchemy.exc.TimeoutError at parallelism 1 and 4, fixed, one source fails, four store, zero handler checkouts, and the log still names the failed domain. Other except paths looked at and left alone: the worker's own session.get of the source (first pooled checkout, outside _process_source), the deferred-source list read in the pass's finally, and the sequential path's source.domain read on the caller session.
